process_file_retrieval: process a file and save its content to the vector database for retrieval
query_collection_retrieval: query a vector collection with hybrid search and reranking to find relevant document chunks
web_search_retrieval: search the web using configurable search engines and process results into vector embeddings
update_embedding_config: update the RAG embedding model configuration including OpenAI, Ollama, and Azure OpenAI settings
update_rag_config: update the full RAG pipeline configuration including chunking, reranking, web search, and content extraction settings
